title: "Bedroom Blues" and loneliness
summary: She talks about writing "Bedroom Blues" after her husband died, her loneliness and the costs of living alone.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: We're just listening to your 'Bedroom Blues.' That's a very moving, very moving, song that you wrote. When you sing, 'I'm all alone, no one done love me at all,' that feeling just comes over so, that's such a powerful thing that you've done there.

Yeah, he's dead, you know, and when you think about your husband being dead, all your family is dead, and you're half sick, you know, and nobody to look out for you but yourself, you know. You got to pay for every little thing you do, you know. But the Lord is good to me and I have --

somebody pick up a piece of paper for me, they're looking for you to pay for it. See, they used to do that, but they know I've got to be a celebrity now and (unintelligible). A man come there and put some plastic window in my window, do you know what he charged me for it? That plastic window cost me maybe about $5.00. He charged me 20. He charged me 20. He put that pipe -- just a little pipe (unintelligible) after Ronnie and them moved here. This house was empty for a little while and it was so cold that it froze in there, you know, and it was leaking, it started leaking. But I couldn't have the water coming in on the floor and ruining my floor. I had (unintelligible). I ain't got nobody to help me (unintelligible). I had to pay all the lights, all the telephone bills, all the electric light bill, all everything, see? And buy all the food -- and you see how my children eat. See, they (unintelligible) in my life.
And that makes you feel lonely.
When did you write that song?
That was about five years ago.
No, that was the man I was going with.
I started going with another man and he ______. My husband
Oh, that's a long time ago.
Yes. My husband died when I was -- wasn't 20 years old.
Oh, is that song that old? "Bedroom Blues?"
